label: Totality esse-cause route controls checked (inference)
rule: Seven explicit all-actual q3a4 interpretations: one joint model, four premise omissions and two strictness models
meaning: Non-transcription closed control bundle. The omission models deny, respectively, the joint claim of A and B for every predicate (Hume-Edwards regress, where the distributive reading satisfies A and fails B), whole to members (internal loop; idle actual explainer) and no self-causation (self-causing totality cause); the joint model shows the premise bundle is satisfiable with an infinite descending chain; the strictness models show CCR without a common uncaused cause, once with a single root on the given edges and once with two independent roots and a transitively closed relation. No model is asserted to be metaphysically possible; the regress relation carries no per se, present or power typing.
